Hi Sophie / Theo —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: schedule a 60–75min evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + success criteria + prompt set handoff) to start the 4-week trial.
- Success criteria we discussed: 1) <10% false positives on entity extraction for pilot dataset, 2) median latency <300ms for 8k token context on our dedicated config, 3) demonstration of prompt-eval pass rate >= 85% for prioritized flows.

Proposed kickoff slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 22 — 10:00–11:15am
- Wed Jun 23 — 2:00–3:15pm

Can you confirm which slot works, or suggest two alternatives? Once we lock time I’ll send a calendar invite with agenda and a brief prework checklist (sample prompts, example payloads, and test dataset access).

I’m attaching a draft trial charter and a mutual action plan so you can review internally. Please flag any procurement or security reviewers we should loop in — I’ll include them on the invite.

Attachments (stubs): trial-charter-template.pdf (high level goals/roles), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (milestones & owners)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Nikhil
